comments.text:
Hi Suhas, I understand how frustrating it can feel when the video keeps getting rejected despite multiple attempts. To help you get this completed smoothly, here are a few key points to keep in mind while capturing the inspection video:

(a) Record the video in natural sunlight, preferably before 6 p.m. on a clear day.
(b) Avoid basements or shaded areas, tree shade, parking sheds, wires, etc., can cause the video to be invalid.
(c) Ensure the vehicle is clean with no water droplets or dust patches.
(d) If there are any dents or scratches, bring the camera closer so they’re clearly visible.
(e) Keep the entire vehicle in frame and avoid any moment where it goes out of focus.

If you want, you can share your contact number at social@policybazaar.com, and we’ll have someone connect with you to guide you through the process step-by-step so this gets resolved without any further hassle.
